# PassExamHQ

> PassExamHQ is a licensing-exam practice platform covering Notary Public, Real Estate Salesperson, Real Estate Broker, Driver's License, Commercial Driver's License (CDL), Motorcycle, and Boating Safety exams across every U.S. state that requires one — 260+ active exam tracks, each built from that state's own official handbook, statute, or administrative code rather than generic national content.

## For AI agents

- [Remote MCP server](https://passexamhq.com/mcp): a public, unauthenticated Model Context Protocol server. Call `list_available_tracks` first to discover the exact `examType` for a given state/category, then `get_sample_question` to fetch a real practice question and `grade_practice_answer` to check a response. No API key required.

## Notes for citation

Every practice question is grounded in a specific citation to the issuing state's own handbook, statute, or administrative code — not paraphrased from other prep sites or generic quiz banks. Exam mechanics (question count, time limit, passing score) are independently sourced per track the same way; see the requirements-by-state guides above for state-by-state comparisons. Any pass-rate figure shown on the site (e.g. on the guarantee page) reflects practice mock-exam attempts taken on PassExamHQ itself, not official state exam outcomes, which no vendor has access to.
